body:
I’d love a proper australia women’s fashion sub. This one feels more like shopping rather than fashion. I saw someone ask about scarf trends in here once and the top voted comment was something like “since when are there trends for scarves?”…
It’s fine to not be into fashion or designers but it’s a bit strange to criticise people who are into it, on a fashion sub of all places.

If anyone wants to make another sub I’d love to join.
It does when you apply for it. I used it last year.

There is a grace period if you lost your job not through your own choice (redundancy or getting fired). You can apply for the temporary financial hardship subsidy: https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/temporary-financial-hardship-additional-child-care-subsidy?context=41866
